title: Electrical Engineer
summary: Support electrical and control system design, coordination and delivery on large data centre and industrial projects.
description: Support electrical and control system design, coordination and delivery on large data centre and industrial projects.

sections.heading: Main Duties and Responsibilities
items: Coordinate electrical infrastructure design and documentation including LV/HV switchgear, lighting, BMS/PMS and safety systems.
Support mechanical integration and junior team development.
Manage client and contractor interfaces, RFQs, variations and long-lead equipment procurement.
Inspect installations against BS standards and local legislation; support testing, commissioning and handover.

sections.heading: Qualifications and Experience
items: Electrical engineering, building services or related degree/HND; chartered status desirable.
Electrical engineering experience and knowledge of BS 7671; data centre, industrial or infrastructure background advantageous.
Microsoft Office, Amtech/Dialux, AutoCAD/Revit and PLC/control system skills.
Right to work in Europe; site experience and full clean driving licence preferred.

sections.heading: Key Competencies & Desirable Attributes
items: Technical precision, problem-solving and multidisciplinary teamwork.
